Server.Name: Project Praxis
Server.Description:
Project Praxis, with ZZTong's Prefabs, is an overhaul for 7 Days to Die by sphereii. It changes where your character comes from: you no longer spend points on a build, you arrive at one by using the skills you want. Praxis means knowledge put into practice - what you can do, rather than what you know on paper.
THIS IS A PROOF OF CONCEPT. It is playable, and it is being played, but it is not finished and it is not balanced. Progression rates especially are still being tuned, and nothing here promises that a world you start today will survive the next update. Treat a save in this pack as one you are willing to lose. If a skill climbs absurdly fast, or sits still for a whole day while you work at it, that is worth saying out loud - finding those is what this build is for.
None of it makes the game easier in the ordinary sense. Zombies hit as hard as they always did, the blood moon still comes, and the world is still trying to kill you. What changes is how you get good at surviving it.
PROGRESSION Swing a club and you get better with clubs. Mine ore and you get better at mining. Every perk levels itself from the actions it governs, and the attribute above it rises from anything in its tree, so committing to a few perks pulls their parent up with them.
Perks and attributes cannot be bought, and levelling up awards no skill points to spend. The skill window becomes somewhere you look at what you have earned rather than somewhere you shop.
Skills fade if you abandon them. Every one carries a hidden inactivity timer, so a wide, shallow character is harder to hold together than a narrow, deep one - everything you are not currently doing is quietly cooling off. Your first few days decide a lot: pick the weapon you actually enjoy and use it, rather than saving it for later.
Level requirements, attribute caps and perk prerequisites are all unchanged, so your level still governs what you are allowed to reach.
COMFORT AND QUALITY OF LIFE Crafting reads from containers near you, so materials need not be hauled into your inventory first. Block upgrades and repairs read from them too, though not while enemies are close. The Drop Box sorts a run's loot back out into the containers that already hold it. Books are shared across a party.
Camera and weapon sway are switched off, flickering POI lights hold steady, and whatever you are aiming at shows a health bar. Locked containers can be picked with a minigame rather than simply refusing you. Chuck and the Rancher have lost their ranged attacks and have to reach you to hurt you.
Scenes implying that a person killed another person, or took their own life, are removed - the bodies hung from posts, and the noose. Ordinary death is left alone: corpses, blood and bones are all still there. Language is softened, and one trader has been persuaded to be civil.
CHALLENGES Around eighty extra challenges sit alongside the ones the game ships with, in three new categories: an Ability set following the five attributes, mostly ten kills with one particular weapon, plus a stealth group asking for sneak kills and unbroken streaks; an SCore set for decapitation, crafting with particular ingredients, fire, harvesting, gathering and clearing every sleeper from a point of interest; and eight NPC hiring challenges.
THE NPC CHALLENGES CANNOT BE COMPLETED IN THIS PACK. They need an NPC mod to supply someone to hire and none is installed. The category is visible but nothing in it will tick over. It is left in place so the challenges are there if you add an NPC pack yourself.
A WIDER WORLD ZZTong-Prefabs, a separate modlet by ZZTong bundled into this pack, adds over two hundred new points of interest, around a hundred and twenty roadside decorations and a set of new city tiles. World generation mixes them in with the stock ones on its own - nothing needs configuring. The decorations are scenery rather than quest locations and take the place of nothing, so having them costs you no POIs. Some of the hunters' traps scattered among them are genuinely lethal, so treat an unfamiliar contraption in the woods with more respect than it appears to deserve.
ZZTong-Prefabs is GPLv3 and is the work of ZZTong, not of this pack. Upstream: https://github.com/zztong/7d2d-prefabs
NOTES EAC must be disabled. The pack ships assemblies and will not load with it on.
On a server, install on the server AND on every client. Server side alone mostly works, but location names and some trigger wiring will not reach you.
In game, press ESC and choose Mod Help for full detail on any of this.
